kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Literally, “Mary's hand”. From the appearance of the plant's branches, put into the tea or charms to ease childbirth, clenching like a hand when drying, equated with female role models in the Abrahamic transmission, Virgin Mary as well as in the later Islamic tradition Aisha and Fatima in some of the synonyms, clenching their fists to endure in childbed.
